    C

    CausalAudit - Interface in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Receives Parsley's per-record causal-buffering events: forwarded, held, released, evicted (causal violation), eviction-limit-exceeded (fail-fast instead of a violation), undecodable, and unresolvable-clock (an undecodable dependencies header at ingest).
    CausalBuffer<K,V> - Record Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Registers one causal source: a topic name paired with the serdes Parsley's buffer uses to (de)serialise records held from that topic.
    CausalBuffer(String, Serde, Serde) - Constructor for record class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalBuffer
    Creates an instance of a CausalBuffer record class.
    CausalBufferLimit - Interface in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Defines when records held in a causal buffer should be evicted.
    CausalDependencies - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    A producer-stamped set of causal requirements: the positions a consumer must have observed before a record stamped with these dependencies may be delivered.
    CausalDependencies.Builder - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Builder for CausalDependencies.
    CausalProcessors - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Factory for CausalProcessorSupplier — the decorating causal processor you drop into a Kafka Streams topology with stream(...).process(...).
    CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Builder for a CausalProcessorSupplier.
    CausalProcessorSupplier<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> - Interface in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    A ProcessorSupplier that wraps an ordinary user ProcessorSupplier so it runs behind Parsley's causal guarantee.
    CausalTopics - Interface in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Resolves a topic name to its stable Kafka UUID — the identity CausalDependencies key their coordinates by, so that a topic deleted and recreated under the same name is treated as a different topic.

    R

    recordClockResolutionFailure(String, int, long, String, boolean) - Method in interface io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalAudit
    An inbound record's parsley-causal-dependencies header could not be decoded into a clock (a corrupt or truncated header, or one in an unsupported wire version).
    recordDeserializationFailure(String, int, long, String, boolean) - Method in interface io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalAudit
    A held record could no longer be deserialised on the forward path (e.g. an incompatible Schema Registry change while buffered).
    recordEvictionLimitExceeded(String, int, long, CausalDependencies) - Method in interface io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalAudit
    A CausalBufferLimit fired on a held record whose dependencies were not yet satisfied, and parsley.buffer.eviction.failure.policy = fail (the default) is configured: the record was not evicted — it remains buffered — and the owning Streams task is about to fail fast rather than deliver it out of causal order.
    recordForwarded(String, int, long) - Method in interface io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalAudit
    A record's causal dependencies were already satisfied; it was forwarded without entering the buffer.
    recordHeld(String, int, long, int, CausalDependencies) - Method in interface io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalAudit
    A record's causal dependencies were not yet satisfied; it was admitted to the buffer to wait.
    recordReleased(String, int, long, int) - Method in interface io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalAudit
    A previously held record became causally satisfiable and was released from the buffer, in causal order.
    recordViolation(String, int, long, CausalDependencies) - Method in interface io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalAudit
    A held record was evicted and forwarded out of causal order because a CausalBufferLimit fired before its dependencies were satisfied — a causal violation.
    require(String, int, long) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalDependencies.Builder
    Requires that (topic, partition) has been observed at offset offset or later.
